notes: Conditionals (COND) is an ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens to msg.sender, the deploying factory at launch. There are no application contracts, transfer fees, or external mint, burn, or administrative functions. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
